theme: 3 terms for smooth transitions between views: an id space, a moving match and a stepped animation

terms.definition: A property wrapper that creates an id space, so views can be matched by their ids.

video.title: Namespace, MatchedGeometryEffect & PhaseAnimator | Day 168
video.description:
Learn to explain how to animate views between screens in SwiftUI: Namespace, MatchedGeometryEffect & PhaseAnimator, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Namespace - A property wrapper that creates an id space, so views can be matched by their ids.
MatchedGeometryEffect - A modifier that animates two views with the same id as if they were one view that moves.
PhaseAnimator - A view that moves through a list of steps and animates from one step to the next.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Namespace, MatchedGeometryEffect & PhaseAnimator in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
네임스페이스, 매치드지오메트리이펙트, 페이즈애니메이터 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Namespace - A property wrapper that creates an id space, so views can be matched by their ids.
한국어: 네임스페이스: 뷰들을 id로 짝지을 수 있게 id 공간을 만들어 주는 프로퍼티 래퍼

MatchedGeometryEffect - A modifier that animates two views with the same id as if they were one view that moves.
한국어: 매치드지오메트리이펙트: 같은 id를 가진 두 뷰를 하나의 뷰가 움직이는 것처럼 애니메이션하는 수정자

PhaseAnimator - A view that moves through a list of steps and animates from one step to the next.
한국어: 페이즈애니메이터: 여러 단계를 차례로 거치면서 한 단계에서 다음 단계로 애니메이션하는 뷰

landscape.hook: Can you explain Namespace, MatchedGeometryEffect and PhaseAnimator in English?

dialogue.title: Grow the thumbnail

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want the thumbnail to grow into the detail photo.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use MatchedGeometryEffect. It animates two views with the same id as one view moving.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do both views in the MatchedGeometryEffect share the same `id`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. They also need the same Namespace.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A property wrapper that creates an id space, so views can be matched by their ids.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I declared `@Namespace var ns` and passed `ns` to `in`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. If the two views use different Namespace values, there is no match.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I want the circle to pulse, again and again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a job for PhaseAnimator. It moves through a list of steps and animates between them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So each step is just a value, like true and false?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The PhaseAnimator starts the next step when the animation ends.
Pass the same Namespace to both views.
